name: mt_benchmarks_bundle
description: A collection of machine-translation (MT) evaluation sets bundled together to measure translation quality across many language pairs and domains. It provides reference translations and standard evaluation splits so researchers can compare models using automatic metrics. The bundle is intended for benchmarking MT systems on both high- and low-resource languages and across diverse genres.
evaluation_method: BLEU (and other MT metrics such as chrF)
reputation: A practical, researcher-oriented dataset bundle on Hugging Face used for routine MT evaluation; moderately adopted in MT research workflows.
